diagnostics.message: the permalink `prerequisites` has no summary, so a product showing its help has none; add a `@summary` to its section
diagnostics.help: Give the section a summary with `@summary`: a sentence or two a product shows in a tooltip or beside an error. Put `@summary` on the line above a paragraph of the section that reads well alone, so it's written once and shown in both places, or write `@summary: <text>` directly under the heading and its `@id` when nothing on the page reads well alone. A project that ships embedded help can raise this check to a warning, so every permalink needs one: `[checks] summary-missing = "warning"`.
